basic_details.job_title: CMO DNH Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Specialist Doctor, Physician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Specialist doctors with MBBS and a PG Degree or Diploma (MS/MD/DNB) in the respective subject can apply for 14 posts on Short Term Contract basis at Sub-District Hospital, Khanvel, advertised by the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, DNH under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, U. T. Administration of Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. Pay ranges from Rs.90,000/- to Rs.1,75,000/- per month depending on degree or diploma and experience, plus an incentive of Rs.25,000/-. Applications in the prescribed format go to the CMO office at the Collectorate, DNH, or by email to [email protecte

how_to_apply: Get the application in the prescribed format; it is printed with the advertisement and the notice says it is available on www.dnh.gov.in.

Write the name of the post applied for and fill in personal details, education (S.S.C., H.S.C., MBBS, Diploma, Post Graduation, any other), work experience and NMC/SMC registration details, as the form asks.
Affix a latest passport size (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm) photograph and sign the declaration; an unsigned application will be rejected.
Attach one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below.
Submit the application to Office of Chief Medical Officer, DNH/Head of Office, B wing Fouth Floor, Collectorate, DNH by 28 November 2026.
Alternatively, the application may be sent via email to [email protected].
Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates
Self-attested copy of valid proof of date of birth
Self-attested copy of valid proof of category (SC / ST / OBC / Others)
Self-attested copies of experience certificates from the organizations / institutions
Self-attested photocopy of registration with NMC / SMC / any other council
important_instructions: The actual number of vacancies may vary as per requirements. The undersigned reserves the right to cancel any applications OR selections at any level without assigning any reason. Tick "x" on information in the form which is not applicable for the post. The declaration states that any statement found untrue at any stage of recruitment or thereafter leads to disqualification and penal action as per rules.

content_sections.heading: CMO DNH Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: U. T. Administration of Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, Department of Health & Family Welfare, O/o. The Chief Medical Officer, DNH
Physician, General Surgeon, Pediatrician, Obstetrician & Gynecologist, Anesthesiologist and other specialist posts
Rs.90,000/- to Rs.1,75,000/- pm plus incentive Rs.25,000/-
Offline (prescribed format to the CMO office); also by email

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 14 specialist posts with one vacancy each. The notice states that the actual number of vacancies may vary as per requirements. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one qualification for all 14 posts, each in its own speciality ("respective subject"). All the qualifications will be considered from recognized universities / Colleges of India. A person who has been previously terminated from any Government organizations / institutions shall not be considered eligible. Age limit: not specified in the notice. The application form asks for the candidate's age as on 28.08.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.post: All 14 posts (Physician to Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Specialist)
rows.essential_qualification: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma in respective subject MS/MD/DNB from an institute recognized by NMC/MCI as per prevailing norms. Candidates should be registered with National Medical Council (NMC) OR State Medical Council (SMC).
rows.desirable: Suitable experience from reputed hospital/institute; Knowledge of Local Language.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMO DNH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Self-attested copy of valid proof of date of birth Self-attested copy of valid proof of category (SC / ST / OBC / Others) Self-attested copies of experience certificates from the organizations / institutions Self-attested photocopy of registration with NMC / SMC / any other council Other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only those candidates who are eligible will be called for interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

rows.event: Last date for submission of application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The actual number of vacancies may vary as per requirements. The undersigned reserves the right to cancel any applications OR selections at any level without assigning any reason. Tick "x" on information in the form which is not applicable for the post. The declaration states that any statement found untrue at any stage of recruitment or thereafter leads to disqualification and penal action as per rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMO DNH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 specialist posts, one each, at Sub-District Hospital, Khanvel; the actual number of vacancies may vary as per requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the DNH specialist doctor posts?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma in respective subject MS/MD/DNB from an institute recognized by NMC/MCI, and registration with NMC or SMC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the specialist posts?
faq.answer: Degree holders get Rs.1,25,000/- pm (fresh) or Rs.1,75,000/- pm (experienced); Diploma holders get Rs.90,000/- pm (fresh) or Rs.1,25,000/- pm (experienced).

faq.question: Q5. Is any incentive paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes, an incentive of Rs.25,000/- per month is added, making gross remuneration Rs.1,15,000/- to Rs.2,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CMO DNH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed application with self-attested documents to Office of Chief Medical Officer, DNH/Head of Office, B wing Fouth Floor, Collectorate, DNH, or email it to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for interview, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending it.

faq.question: Q8. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No, the posts are to be filled on Short Term Contract (STC) basis.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: A person who has been previously terminated from any Government organizations / institutions shall not be considered eligible.
